cards.card_text: I can't get over that, friend, and THEN they look up and see a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, camels carrying spices, balm and myrrh.
cards.verse_text: Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.
cards.snippet: Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.

cards.card_text: Then the speaker asks, 'Is there no balm in Gilead?
cards.verse_text: Is there no balm in Gilead?
cards.snippet: Is there no balm in Gilead?

cards.card_text: Then the message speaks straight to Egypt, calling her the Virgin Daughter of Egypt, and tells her to go up to Gilead, a land east of the Jordan River, for balm.
cards.verse_text: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt!
cards.snippet: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt!

cards.card_text: Egypt is told to go up to Gilead for balm.
cards.verse_text: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt!
cards.snippet: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt!

cards.card_text: Wail for her and get her balm Rebuild her walls right away Crown a new king over her
cards.verse_text: Wail for her; get her balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.
cards.snippet: Wail for her; get her balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.
